roots.title: Canonical domain not centralized
roots.why_it_matters: A single hardcoded literal, duplicated 7+ places, silently drifts whenever the actual production domain changes -- this is a generic failure mode, not specific to domains.
manifestations: AI chat CORS origin check mismatch
roots.resolution: commit cd7d6d7 -- single sed-verified sweep, grep confirms 0 remaining occurrences

roots.title: functions/api/contact.js treated all paths as success
roots.why_it_matters: A single design assumption ("always tell the user it worked") produced three independent-looking findings that were actually one root cause: the function never distinguished "received" from "confirmed" from "logged only".
manifestations: PII in logs used as the only fallback record (SEC-001)
unescaped fields only mattered because the email path was trusted uncritically (SEC-002 compounds the same root)

roots.title: Two Cloudflare deployment architectures configured simultaneously, neither fully correct
roots.why_it_matters: wrangler.jsonc is Workers-shaped; CI deploys via Pages action; src/entrypoint.js hand-rolls a bypass of the official Workers migration path and never wires in the security-header middleware. One architectural ambiguity produced a working-but-incomplete production system.
manifestations: wildcard/prefix CORS (independently discovered, same root: nobody had committed to one security-header owner)
zero security headers on live API responses (DEBT-0011, still open)
no _routes.json (would have meant unlimited Pages Function invocations on static assets, had Pages ever actually deployed)
roots.recommended_wave: WAVE-1 (CI job removed, commit 296f6a3) + WAVE-2 (entrypoint header fix, not yet authorized)
roots.resolution: Decision: WORKERS -- CONDITIONAL GO, 80% confidence (audit/cloudflare-decision/). CI job removed (296f6a3). Entrypoint header fix NOT implemented -- requires explicit authorization per this session's "no implementation without approval" boundary.

roots.title: Legal/structured-data/medical content was never derived from or verified against the actual implementation
roots.why_it_matters: privacy.astro, the AggregateRating block, and og-image reference were all authored independently of what the codebase actually does or contains -- a generic "content written without an evidence check" failure mode.
manifestations: medical claims with no provenance metadata (CONTENT-001, still open, needs clinical review not engineering)
roots.recommended_wave: WAVE-1 (3 of 4 fixed) + WAVE-4 (CONTENT-001, needs a human clinical decision)

roots.title: No automated test suite exists at any layer
roots.why_it_matters: Every fix made in this session (10 RESOLVED debt items) has zero regression protection. This is the single highest-leverage remaining root cause: it doesn't just represent one debt item, it multiplies the risk of every other item silently regressing.
manifestations: CI can only catch type/build errors, not behavioral regressions
the fail-closed contact-API fix (DEBT-0002) has no test proving it stays fail-closed
the rate-limiter (DEBT-0007) has no test proving it actually limits
roots.resolution: Not started. Recommended first tests (highest value per this session's own fixes): contact API fail-closed behavior, chat rate-limit enforcement, domain-canonicalization regression (grep-based, cheap).

roots.title: Release-critical checks are structurally non-blocking
roots.why_it_matters: continue-on-error on npm audit and Lighthouse means no CI signal can ever actually stop a bad release -- a policy decision with two visible symptoms.
manifestations: CI-002 (Node version mismatch across workflows, a smaller but related CI-hygiene gap)

roots.title: Pre-existing accessibility work never completed
roots.status: OPEN (explicitly deferred per user's own ordering)
roots.why_it_matters: Design-intelligence Stage 16 already found and evidenced these; they were deliberately sequenced after the P1 token-model work per explicit user instruction, then superseded in priority by the third-party audit's Wave 1. Not forgotten -- sequenced.
manifestations: the same 6 axe-core violations from design-intelligence Stage 16 (color-contrast x4 routes, missing label, invalid ARIA)
roots.recommended_wave: WAVE-5, or sooner if the user re-prioritizes

roots.title: Appointment flow conflates "message drafted" with "appointment booked"
roots.why_it_matters: A single UX/product framing choice (calling a WhatsApp-draft flow "booking") is the entire root cause of APP-001 -- there is no second manifestation because this is a single, self-contained product decision, not a systemic pattern.
manifestations: APP-001 (WhatsApp draft presented as booking success)
roots.recommended_wave: Needs a product decision before any wave -- not purely an engineering fix
